t.E907.agn: In 2020 EFSA stated that its acute toxicity is low and that there is no concern for genotoxicity; based on a 90-day rat study it set an ADI of 20 mg/kg body weight/day. Even in the highest exposure scenario, intake remained below this limit.
t.E907.body: Hydrogenated poly-1-decene is very poorly absorbed from the digestive tract: in rats 92–102% of the dose was excreted in faeces, and the amount excreted in bile and urine was below 1%.
t.E907.found.0: Confectionery and chewing gum (glazing agent, max. 2,000 mg/kg)
t.E907.prod: A polymer produced by chemical synthesis.
t.E907.regx.0: Re-evaluated; ADI 20 mg/kg body weight/day, no safety concern at the authorised levels.
t.E907.summary: A synthetic, petroleum-derived hydrocarbon. Used as a glazing coating on confectionery and dried fruit.
t.E907.what: A synthetic hydrocarbon polymer; used as a glazing agent.
